shots.text: The day it changed, Kesh picked an old worker from my colony. The ant who used to feed me in the nursery.
shots.note: The chained trap-jaws in the cold chamber. Kesh walks the line and stops at the old worker.

shots.text: He raised his stinger, and before I even decided to, I moved.
shots.note: Kesh rears up over the old worker, stinger high. 250 lunges.

shots.text: Kesh dropped, and the whole chamber went silent. I waited for them to kill me.
shots.note: Kesh dead on his back. Every fire ant frozen.

shots.text: Instead, the fire queen's general stepped forward, looked at the body, then looked at me.
shots.note: The fire queen's general, gold-rimmed, steps out of the smoke.

shots.text: "You," he said. "You fight for us now."
I should've said no. I should've stood with my own.
shots.note: His own colony, still in chains.

shots.text: But when they gave me Kesh's armor and the fire soldiers stepped aside as I walked past...
shots.note: 250 in Kesh's red armor, walking at the head of the fire soldiers.
Close-up in the armor; the green veins pulse.
Close on the old worker in chains.

shots.text: I didn't answer. I didn't even look back.
shots.note: 250 walks on in the armor, away from them.
